tldr: Canonical headline ownership belongs to thm:certified-finite-cancellation-precision and thm:certified-cancellation-cap-regions. A separable indirect incidence can remain nonzero at exact endpoint cancellation. For four unknown primitive Hölder hazards and one randomized categorical inspection per subject, the proved finite-sample minimax root-MSE and honest connected-interval expected length have the same order \(\max\{n^{-1/2},n^{-(4\beta+2)/(4\beta+5)},\delta n^{-(\beta+1)/(2\beta+3)}\}\). The surface covers every shrinking cap; exact cancellation retains a roughness obstruction below \(\beta=1/4\), while the critical value has no logarithm. A finite rational certificate grammar, decidable checker and soundness proof justify numerical implementation of the same selected estimator. The theorem is scoped to the stated four-hazard class; exact theorem-level priority comparisons with final Laurent, Maathuis Chapter 7 and Jewell--van der Laan--Henneman remain limited by source access.
